sandbachFocus: Leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00, looking to extend their excellent form. Sandbach are unbeaten in their last five matches (four wins and a draw) and sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games. They face a struggling Alsager Town side who occupy the bottom three with just 4 points and have lost five of their last six.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture that could see them close the gap on leaders Sandbach if they secure victory. Third-placed AFC Bridgnorth visit Eccleshall in a meeting of two mid-table sides, with Eccleshall looking to bounce back from a recent defeat. Wolverhampton Casuals host Wednesfield Community in a local derby with both sides in the upper half. In-form Bilston Town (five wins in their last six) entertain Foley Meir, while struggling Widnes Town travel to Brereton Social still seeking their first league win. Cheadle Heath Nomads host Telford Town in a clash between two of the division's lower-ranked sides, and Market Drayton Town welcome New Mills as both seek to climb away from the bottom half. Crewe face Allscott Heath and Shawbury United travel to Barnton in fixtures involving sides in mixed form.
